Dialogue:
星芒マーケットが開催中だ！
楽しんでいってくれ！
Come an' enjoy yerself at the Starlight Stalls!

子どものための祝祭か…
皇都でも開催を検討しよう
Perhaps we should consider holding similar festivities for the children of Ishgard.

星芒祭をするなら
マエリも手伝うよ！
Oh, can we? I'll help!

これが星芒祭か
なかなか興味深いものだ
This Starlight Celebration is most fascinating, I must grrr.

しっかり見て回って
レポートを書かないとね
Yes, but we mustn't get distracted. We need to take thorough notes for our report!

守護天節を見たかったけど…
この祝祭も悪くないわね
I would have preferred our trip to coincide with All Saints' Wake, but...this has a certain charm.

もしかして…
この白いのは雪ってやつか？
Is this white stuff...*snow*?
なんだそれ、食えるのか？
Can you eat it?

この国民的祝祭から
学ぶべきものは多そうだ
A festival so evidently loved by the people makes a fine source of inspiration, wouldn't you agree?

子どもの味方、赤い聖人闘士！
いいかもしれないぞ…
“Introducing the red-robed defender of children: the Saint!” Yes, it has potential...

子どものための祝祭とは
外つ国には学びが多いな
A celebration bringing joy to children! Marvelous, truly marvelous.

俺もイヒーハナ祭とは違う
祝祭を見れてよかったよ
And fascinating to see a festival so different to Ihih'hana.

この煌びやかな装飾…
トラルにはない光景だな
Would you just look at these decorations! I've not come across anything like *this* in Tural.

参考にして列車の内装を
期間限定で変えてみるかい？
Say, how about we change up the carriage interiors every now and then? Make it festive!

それには賛成するけどさ
ふたりとも寒くないの？
That's fine and all, but...aren't you two cold?

このしっとり冷たい空気
乾いた荒野育ちには堪えるぜ…
The chill, damp air is too much for a Shaaloani boy like me!

ギルドで育てた自慢の品々
どうぞご覧ください
Trust the guild for the finest produce!
従者様のソリ見たかったな
I wanted to see the little helper's sleigh!
私は作るの手伝いたかった！
And *I* wanted to help make it!

ソリ作りで忙しくても
一家団らんしてる…！
The guildmaster still finds time to dote on her children, even though she's in such demand...!

今回もキンダープンシュを
サービスとして配ってるよ
Free kinderpunsch for visitors to the Starlight Stalls!

海都風キンダープンシュを
一杯どうだ？
How about a cup o' Lominsan punch to warm your cockles?

チョコボとの
ふれあいはどう？
Would you like to meet our chocobos?

キンダープンシュ
美味しいね！
Ahhh, the kinderpunsch is so good...

飲み終わったら
別の種類も試そうね！
Let's try a different flavor next!

イェイッ、イェイッ♪
イェーーーーーイ♪
Yip, yip!♪ Yiiiiiip!♪
へっ、ゴキケンだなルディ！
What a lovely song, Rudy!
きれいなソリだね！
It's so pretty!
これに乗れるって本当かな？
Can you really ride it, do you think?

聖人様たちと一緒に
ソリを作ったんだぜ！
We helped the saint make a sleigh.

私は座席のシートを
革細工師の人と作ったの
I made the seat with a nice leatherworker lady!

すごーい！
次あったら私も手伝いたい！
Wow! If you make another one, let me help too!

僕の友だちにも
ソリを見せてみたいな
I wonder what my friends would say if I rode a sleigh to see them...!

ソリに乗って世界を冒険なんて
面白そうかも…
Traveling the world on a sleigh...now that's an idea!

この光景
なんだか懐かしいな
There's something oddly comforting about all this...

ゆっくり過ごすのは
新鮮だ
It's peaceful, for one thing. We don't get much of that in our line of work.

クマの人形が
流行りなのか？
...Bear costumes, eh? Not the worst choice, I suppose.
わーい！
Hooray!

キャハハ！
みーつけた！
Ahaha! Found you, Dodd!
しーっ…
O-Oh, dear...

飾りのフリをして
隠れられそうですネ
Oho... They'll never find me in a decor disguise.

棺の中から
バァッと…！？
Perhaps the Impresario's in a coffin, waiting for the right moment to emerge...
ドコダアァァ！
Oh, Impresariooo! Where did you go!?
逃げられると思うなよ～
Heh heh... You can't hide from me!

おまぢないで
隠れるでふっち…！
This one will use magicks to hide!
数えるふっちよ～
Oh! Then this one will count!
すぐ見つけるふっち！
And *this one* will find hiding one!
ふふ…
Excellent... I daresay I'm unspottable.
総長はどこへ…？
L-Lord Commander!? S-Show yourself this instant!
このあたりのはずだ…！
He must be around here somewhere.
ちょちょいのちょいだぜ！
Sicard, old boy! I know you're out there!

ボンクラ貴族にゃ
負けねぇ！
Heh! Blue-blooded bastard'll be searchin' a while longer, I wager.

あんまり遠くには
行ってないよな…？
Azami! She can't have gone *that* far...right?

イッセにい
見つけてくれるかな？
Hee hee... I wonder if he'll think to look here!

喋ったら
すぐ見つかっちゃいますよ
Were you two actually planning on hiding, or...?

オブリビオンのみんなにも
見せてみたいです
We absolutely *must* tell the rest of Oblivion about it!

し、障壁の外は…
刺激的ですね…
They certainly host some...interesting events beyond the dome.

An oglop has been nesting here...
Not in my clean, shiny city!
Step right up, ladies and gents!
We've a treasure trove of prizes just waiting to be claimed!
And remember: don't panic! Just type away, and have fun!
It's called a *brawler*! How was I to know you don't win by punching the keys?
I refuse to leave until I see this game through to its end!
Mother's going to be very cross with you.
I am one with the keys!
That's the spirit, dearie. We *will* have our revenge!
Oh, dear... I can't feel my fingers. Perhaps I typed too hard...?
さァ、楽しい饗宴だゾー！
Come, join the revelry!
ヒヒ…この扉の先には…
Heehee... Wayward spirits abide beyond that door...
遊びまショー！
Leave your worries to wither and die!
バァ～！
Boo!

落ちたラもう
戻ってこられないヨォ…
Watch your step... Or you may never see the light of day again!
ガタガタ！ガタガタ！
Who's there!? Who, I say!?
ギシギシ…ヒヒヒ…
Hee hee hee...!

ヨってらっしゃイ！
ミてらっしゃ～イ！
Come one, come all!
クルル…ニャーン…
Prrr... Meow.
ニャニャン…？
M-Meow...?
Hmm, the area's been swallowed up by the wood...
Let's visit Mother's grave afterwards, shall we?
I want to learn how to play a musical instrument too!
Why not? When ye get good, ye can perform fer Nimuili an' Bathu.
I'm sure they'd like that.
It's a fine atmosphere for the Rising─solemn but hopeful.
Truly. The westerly breeze brings a sense of renewal.
So, what shall we do next?
Whatever it is, let's invite Nhagi and Nimuili!

星芒マーケットへ
ようこそー！
Welcome to the Starlight Stalls!
We're glad to be of service!
Are the herbs to your satisfaction?
Aye, they're perfect. You two never let me down.
Another day, another mech op done!
Phew. That was quite the ordeal...
Bit of a scramble, but mission accomplished.
Bit of a scramble... Time for a break.
But you can leave any fiends that appear to me!

その魔物…
よく懐いてるな
I trust your friend is docile?

うわ、びっくりした
魔獣使いの魔物か…
A beastmaster!?

その魔物…
いくらなら売ってくれる？
How much for the beastie, eh?
おっと、魔獣使いか…
Greetings, beastmaster.
魔物の管理はしっかりな
Take care your pet doesn't stray.

ほう…
いい使役獣だな
What a fine beast!

へえ…
魔獣使いの使役獣ってやつか？
Taking your familiar on a stroll?

最近、魔物連れの奴が
増えた気がしないか？
Feels like everyone's got a beast these days...

そんな魔物がいれば
海賊も大人しくなりそうだ
I reckon you two could take on any pirate.
What a beautiful piece. Let's go with it, kweh...
